scenarios.root_cause: Agent's run_shell_command calls fail in two ways on Windows: `dir ~/...` errors because cmd.exe doesn't expand `~`, and the corrected PowerShell `Get-ChildItem` variant is auto-denied by the security policy (not queued for user approval). In both turns the agent then generates a '### First Tool Execution' heading but is truncated before actually invoking the planned fallback tools (browse_directory, find_files), leaving both responses incomplete with no usable output.

recommended_fix.description: Auto-approve basic read-only listing commands (dir, Get-ChildItem with no mutating flags) without requiring manual user permission, and/or expand ~ to %USERPROFILE% before passing the path to cmd.exe dir. Additionally, investigate why the agent consistently stops generating after a markdown heading — the response truncation pattern suggests a generation termination issue that prevents planned fallback tool calls from being executed.
